summary: Remove files/directories synchronously while preserving recursive, force, and retry semantics.

semantics.force: suppresses missing-path error but does not mean ignore all errors
semantics.retries: maxRetries/retryDelay apply only to selected errors in recursive mode

caveats: File.Delete/Directory.Delete do not jointly reproduce Node rm semantics.
force:true must not swallow arbitrary permission or I/O errors.
Retry behavior is observable in timing/error outcomes and is platform-sensitive.

tests.name: force missing succeeds
tests.expected_behavior: returns undefined without throwing solely because the path is absent

tests.name: nonrecursive nonempty directory fails
tests.expected_behavior: does not silently recursively delete a non-empty directory without recursive:true
